instruction.text: Match the figures of speech with their correct names.

atoms.a: an exaggeration which is used to emphasise something
when an animal or object is given human traits
one thing is described as being something else
two unlike things are compared with one another

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the metaphor that makes sense in this sentence.

atoms.b: I was going to jump, but I got ((++cold_feet two_left_feet)).
Thank you so much for your help. You are ((++an_angel a_night_owl)).
I am so hungry. My stomach is a ((++black_hole green_carpet)).
Yesterday, ((the vending machine)) ate my money.
atoms.sound: Yesterday, the vending machine ate my money.

atoms.a: What human trait is given to the vending machine?

b: The machine gave out too many products.
++The machine took the money without giving out the product.

atoms.sound: Their new sofa cost a fortune.

atoms.a: What does the hyperbole in the sentence express?
b: Their new sofa was rather cheap.

trainers.instruction: Which figure of speech can be found in the sentence?

atoms.a: This is the worst day of my life.
My dad is a teddy bear.
The chocolate bar is begging me to eat it.
